process_notes: Gate order: run BOTH cargo-ci AND code-review on the worker branch/merge BEFORE marking done. (118a0091 was merged after cargo-ci but before code-review, which then failed; fixed forward.)
cargo-ci gate has a hard 300s timeout. Cold full --all-features build (HIP via hipcc) exceeds it; PRE-WARM with ./scripts/cargo-ci.sh after merge, then run the gate (incremental ~130s).
Pre-existing main breakage fixed: sim_checkpoint_helper.rs was fmt-dirty (commit d456b685), making cargo-ci fmt step red independent of this epic.
Disk at 93% (70GB main target/). Workers MUST use targeted -p builds, not --workspace --all-features, in worktrees.
Background worker wait-loops end their turn on each Monitor poll, causing notification churn; instruct a single PID-exit wait.
